1: // Minimal Gravity Flip Game
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas with id="game"
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;

8: // Player

10:   x: 50,
11:   y: canvas.height / 2,
12:   w: 20,
13:   h: 20,
14:   vy: 0,
15:   speed: 2,
16:   gravity: 0.4,
17:   dir: 1 // 1 = down, -1 = up
18: };
19: 
20: let obstacles = [];
21: let frames = 0;
22: let gameOver = false;
23: let speedFactor = 1;
24: 
25: function toggleGravity() {
26:   player.dir *= -1;
27: }
28: 
29: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
30:   if (e.code === 'Space') toggleGravity();
31: });
32: canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleGravity);

34: function spawnObstacle() {
35:   const gapHeight = 80 + Math.random() * 40;
36:   const gapY = Math.random() * (canvas.height - gapHeight);
37:   const w = 30;
38:   obstacles.push({x: canvas.width, w, gapY, gapHeight, type: 'platform'});
39:   // occasional spike
40:   if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
41:     const spikeY = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : canvas.height;
42:     obstacles.push({x: canvas.width, w: 20, y: spikeY, h: 20, type: 'spike'});
43:   }
44: }
45: 
46: function update() {
47:   if (gameOver) return;
48:   frames++;
49:   // Increase speed over time
50:   if (frames % 600 === 0) speedFactor += 0.1;
51: 
52:   // Player physics
53:   player.vy += player.gravity * player.dir * speedFactor;
54:   player.y += player.vy;
55: 
56:   // Move player forward
57:   player.x += player.speed * speedFactor;
58: 
59:   // Keep player within horizontal bounds (wrap)
60:   if (player.x > canvas.width) player.x = 0;
61: 
62:   // Update obstacles
63:   obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= 2 * speedFactor);
64:   // Remove off‑screen obstacles
65:   obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
66: 
67:   // Spawn new obstacles
68:   if (frames % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
69: 
70:   // Collision detection
71:   // With spikes
72:   for (const o of obstacles) {
73:     if (o.type === 'spike') {
74:       if (
75:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
76:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
77:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
78:         player.y + player.h > o.y
79:       ) {
80:         gameOver = true;
81:       }
82:     } else {
83:       // Platform with gap – player must be inside gap
84:       if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x) {
85:         if (player.y < o.gapY || player.y + player.h > o.gapY + o.gapHeight) {
86:           gameOver = true;
87:         }
88:       }
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   // Lose if player leaves canvas vertically
93:   if (player.y < -player.h || player.y > canvas.height) gameOver = true;
94: }
95:

97:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
98:

102: 
103:   // Draw obstacles

105:   obstacles.forEach(o => {

114:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, canvas.height - o.h);

116:       }
117:       ctx.closePath();
118:       ctx.fill();
119:     } else {
120:       // upper platform
121:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, o.w, o.gapY);
122:       // lower platform
123:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.gapY + o.gapHeight, o.w, canvas.height - (o.gapY + o.gapHeight));
124:     }
125:   });

128:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
129:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
